channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-117524 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not perform a status or capability check when resolving post identifiers passed to one of its shortcodes, allowing authenticated users with at least the Contributor role to disclose the content of other users' draft, private and password-protected posts. An Author can republish that content to anonymous visitors.

item.title: CVE-2026-118041 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Contest Gallery WordPress plugin before 34.0.3 does not sanitise the name of files uploaded through its e-commerce sale file-replacement feature, allowing authenticated users with Author-level access and above to write files with an arbitrary name and extension to a web-accessible directory and, by overwriting the directory's protection file through the same flow, achieve Remote Code Execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-118241 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Smush WordPress plugin before 4.3.6 does not verify that a user is authorised to act on the targeted media attachment, only checking a broad upload-files capability, which allows users with the Author role and above to optimise and restore attachments owned by other users, altering their files on disk and consuming the stored backup.

item.title: CVE-2026-118418 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3 does not restrict which database models and columns its public directory-search action may return, nor verify authorisation on it, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read other users' personal data, including email addresses and logins, and private contact-form submissions.

item.title: CVE-2026-118420 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, making it possible for users holding the WP Directory Kit WordPress plugin before 1.6.3's custom Listing Admin role, and above, to perform SQL injection attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-118439 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Limit Login Attempts Security WordPress plugin before 3.4.2 does not validate the destination of a server-side request built from a user-supplied setup value, allowing users with administrator privileges to make the site issue requests to arbitrary hosts, including internal ones (SSRF).

item.title: CVE-2026-119032 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70 does not check that the importing user may edit the posts named in a settings backup, nor restrict the import to its own post types, allowing users whose role an administrator has granted access to the Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70's settings to modify, re-author, unpublish or trash any post or page on the site and write arbitrary post meta.

item.title: CVE-2026-119033 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70 does not verify that a user may edit a post before letting them change that post's structured data settings, allowing users with the Contributor role and above, when an administrator has granted them access to the Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70, to disable, alter or reset the structured data of posts they do not own.

item.title: CVE-2026-119034 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70 does not verify that a post is publicly viewable before returning its approved comments through the review feature, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read approved comments on private, draft and password-protected posts, and to retrieve approved comments site-wide.

item.title: CVE-2026-119035 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP WordPress plugin before 1.70 does not safely encode its structured data output when the Pretty Print option is enabled, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks when the site maps a schema property to a custom field.

item.title: CVE-2026-119303 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The NotificationX WordPress plugin before 3.3.7 does not perform any capability or nonce check on one of its REST routes, allowing unauthenticated users to update a NotificationX WordPress plugin before 3.3.7 option and to repeatedly trigger emails sent through the site's own mail server.

item.title: CVE-2026-119529 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Gravity Forms WordPress plugin before 3.2.2 does not properly restrict the file types that unauthenticated users can upload through its chunked file upload feature, allowing them to read server environment variables and the contents of files within the web root on servers configured to parse Server-Side Include documents, such as Apache with SSI enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-119531 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Live Composer WordPress plugin before 2.1.24 does not escape several attributes of one of its page-builder shortcodes before outputting them inside HTML tag attributes, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to store a payload that executes in the browser of anyone who views the post, including an administrator reviewing the pending submission.

item.title: CVE-2026-121472 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The AutomatorWP WordPress plugin before 6.0.8 does not bind the requests that complete its Zoom and AWeber integration connections to the administrator who started them, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator replace the stored integration credentials with the attacker's own via a CSRF attack, diverting the data the site sends to those services into an account the attacker controls. Exploitation requires the integration to already be connected and knowledge of the site's OAuth client identifier.

item.title: CVE-2026-121497 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The AskAny WordPress plugin before 2.2.0 does not validate the extension or content of files attached to chat messages, trusting the browser-supplied file type instead, which allows unauthenticated users to upload PHP files and execute arbitrary code when visitor attachments are enabled.

item.title: CVE-2026-121862 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Knowledge Building WordPress plugin before 0.7.3 does not sanitise and escape comments submitted through its reply feature, and publishes them without moderation, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against any visitor of the affected posts, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-121863 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Knowledge Building WordPress plugin before 0.7.3 does not escape several user-supplied values before echoing them back in the response of an AJAX action available to unauthenticated users, and serves that response as HTML, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting.

item.title: CVE-2026-121870 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Simpler Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.5.4 does not properly restrict who can create orders and checks its automatic login link with a key that stays empty until the store owner configures the Simpler Checkout WordPress plugin before 1.5.4, allowing subscribers on stores that have not completed setup to log in as an administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-121873 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Redirection for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 3.2.16 does not verify ownership of the email address supplied through its data request form action and by default records the resulting request as already confirmed, allowing unauthenticated visitors to create verified WordPress personal data erasure or export requests for addresses they do not control.

item.title: CVE-2026-121998 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The iChart WordPress plugin before 2.2.4 does not perform capability or ownership checks in several of its AJAX actions, relying only on a nonce that any logged-in user can obtain, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to read, modify and permanently delete arbitrary posts and to overwrite a site-wide option.

item.title: CVE-2026-122061 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets and Registration WordPress plugin before 5.30.3.1 does not correctly check whether an event displays a public attendee list before returning one of its attendees over the REST API, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the names of attendees of events that do not show a public attendee list.

item.title: CVE-2026-122087 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Event Tickets and Registration WordPress plugin before 5.30.3.1 does not restrict attendee data to events the requester is allowed to view, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the attendees of private and other non-public events.

item.title: CVE-2026-123134 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Smoove abandoned cart trigger for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 4.3.6 does not sanitise and escape abandoned-cart data submitted by visitors before outputting it in the admin dashboard, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-123656 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.17.6 does not correctly evaluate some of its content protection rule conditions when content is rendered outside the main query, allowing unauthenticated users to read the content of pages protected by such rules via the REST API.

item.title: CVE-2026-123657 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.17.6 does not reject negative membership plan identifiers before checking whether a plan is active, allowing unauthenticated visitors to sign up for membership plans an administrator has deactivated and receive the role attached to them.

item.title: CVE-2026-123661 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.17.4 does not check that a membership plan is still active when checkout is used to change an existing subscription, allowing subscribers holding any subscription of their own to subscribe to plans the site owner has deactivated, including free plans that grant a user role.

item.title: CVE-2026-123666 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Photo Engine (Media Organizer & Lightroom) WordPress plugin before 6.6.2 does not check that a user may delete the media in a collection before deleting it along with the collection, allowing users with the Author role and above to permanently delete other users' synced media, including administrators'.

item.title: CVE-2026-123667 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Photo Engine (Media Organizer & Lightroom) WordPress plugin before 6.6.2 does not sanitise and escape keyword names before storing them and outputting them on its debugging page, allowing users with the Author role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators who have enabled that page.

item.title: CVE-2026-123695 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict access to several of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated users to generate login tokens for every user and then retrieve them, and so log in as any user, including administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-123696 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before resetting two-factor authentication enrolment, allowing unauthenticated users to remove the second factor from any account, or from every account at once.

item.title: CVE-2026-123697 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict who can request a user's current two-factor code or two-factor secret, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain them for any account and bypass the second factor on sites where its one-time password library is available.

item.title: CVE-2026-123698 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict access to one of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve its full settings, including configured secret keys and the hidden login URL.

item.title: CVE-2026-123699 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before running bulk Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16, and WordPress core updates, allowing unauthenticated users to force every pending update to be installed on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-123700 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before running several of its comment cleanup actions, allowing unauthenticated users to permanently delete all comments on the site, including approved ones and WooCommerce order notes.

item.title: CVE-2026-123701 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not have proper authorization checks when resetting its settings, allowing unauthenticated users to reset any section of its configuration to the defaults and so disable security features such as a custom login URL, two-factor authentication, reCAPTCHA, password policies and the firewall.

item.title: CVE-2026-123702 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before regenerating the secret keys and salts in the site's configuration file, allowing unauthenticated users to log out every user and, on servers that cannot reach the WordPress.org API, corrupt the configuration file and take the whole site offline.

item.title: CVE-2026-123703 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not check that the requester is authorised before ending a user's login sessions, allowing unauthenticated visitors to log out any user, including administrators, and to keep them logged out by repeating the request.

item.title: CVE-2026-123704 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict access to one of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the email address of every administrator on the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-123705 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 does not restrict access to one of its REST API routes, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve a detailed report of the server, PHP and WordPress configuration, including installed Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin through 1.0.16 and versions and the site administrator's email address.

item.title: CVE-2026-88813 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Wednesday 11 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | The YITH WooCommerce Gift Cards WordPress plugin through 4.39.0 does not reconcile the value of a gift card it issues against the amount actually paid for it, instead crediting the new card with the item's pre-discount price, which allows customers to apply an ordinary store coupon at checkout and receive a gift card worth more than they paid.
